task: For one caller-known DOI, retrieve a source-specific record projection, including provider resource classification, rights, relations, and schema identity where exposed.

method.permission: five explicitly invoked public metadata GETs; no credentials
openalex_follow_up_calls: one repeat of the existing OpenAlex DOI-filter adapter after its first NETWORK_ERROR

unique_remaining_use_cases: Return DataCite-registered resourceTypeGeneral and resourceType, rightsList, relatedIdentifiers, schemaVersion, and state for a caller-known DOI.
findings: For this purposively selected DOI, the new DataCite adapter and an OpenAlex direct DOI endpoint both returned dataset-typed records with the same title and year, using provider-specific schemas.

The existing bounded OpenAlex DOI-filter wrapper returned NETWORK_ERROR once and then HTTP 200 with NO_RESULT_FOR_FILTER; a direct OpenAlex DOI endpoint request returned the exact Work. This is an observed route-specific difference, not evidence that the work is absent.

The DataCite projection uniquely exposed the DataCite schema version, state, resourceTypeGeneral/resourceType, and bounded rights/related-identifier field status. OpenAlex returns OpenAlex Work identity and its own metadata/location fields.
Crossref returned HTTP 404 for the DOI in the comparison call; this does not establish that the DOI or work does not exist.

One purposively selected DOI establishes no provider ranking, coverage, quality, reliability, latency, or cost conclusion. Preserve the tools for provider-specific outputs; replacement value remains unknown outside this task.

claim_ceiling: One live DOI comparison only; provider response fields are not scientific truth, source-authenticity, legal-reuse, content-access, or coverage judgments.
